display.purpose: Page H1s on the dark ground (Inter 500). Job-boards H1 36px to 72px; shared split header (values, initiatives) 56px to 96px; homepage hero to 74px.

headline.purpose: Section headings on either ground; emphasised or encircled word bold.

title.purpose: ClashDisplay 600 names a visitor clicks in a list: board and tool names.

value-name.purpose: ClashDisplay 600 value name: 36px to 60px (fluid) on the charter tiles, 36px to 40px in the homepage list, 36px to 72px as value-row headings. In the value's ink on the dark ground; tile names take the tile's text colour.

door-action.purpose: ClashDisplay 700 action at the foot of a door card: 24px, 30px from lg, 32px at xl, before the black arrow circle.

cta.purpose: ClashDisplay 700 label inside the large pill buttons.

body.purpose: All reading copy; line-height 1.6875; ledes max 42rem.

label.purpose: Nav, filter pills, field labels, table headers (Inter 700). Inter 500 and 700 render as Regular by design; see The One-Weight Inter Rule.

shadows.name: toolbar-stuck
shadows.purpose: State-only hairline under the sticky filter toolbar while rows scroll beneath it. No resting shadows exist.

motion.name: color-hover
motion.value: 200ms ease-in
motion.purpose: Colour fills on nav pill and filter pills.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.value: 150ms
motion.purpose: Table row #ECECEC fill.

motion.name: cta-scale
motion.value: transform scale(1.05), 150ms ease-in
motion.purpose: CTA pill hover; no shadow.

motion.name: menu-reveal
motion.value: opacity + translateY(-0.5rem), 100ms ease-in
motion.purpose: Mobile menu overlay.

motion.name: nudge
motion.value: translate 4px (arrow: down on tiles, right on doors), 200-300ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrow circle responds inside a hovered tile or door.

motion.name: toolbar-stuck
motion.value: box-shadow 200ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Stuck toolbar hairline fade.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions 0.01ms, scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion override in global.css.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: expo.out
motion.purpose: GSAP ease for reveals, split lines and staggered grids. Big things move slower than small ones.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.value: expo.inOut
motion.purpose: GSAP ease for the page curtain (transitions.ts).

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.value: power3.out
motion.purpose: Hovers and small settles: card tilt (0.3s), nav hide (0.25s), refiltered job rows (0.4s).

motion.name: line-reveal
motion.value: 1.0-1.3s, stagger 0.06-0.1, ease-out (data-split lines: 1.2s, 0.08)
motion.purpose: Masked text lines rising into view on scroll (data-split).

motion.name: clip-reveal
motion.value: 1.2-1.6s, ease-out, clip-path inset 100% to 0% (data-reveal clip and scale: 1.4s)
motion.purpose: Clip-path reveal. The clip is cleared at the end so focus rings are not cut.

motion.name: curtain
motion.value: 0.8-1.1s, ease-in-out (leave 0.8s, enter 0.9s)
motion.purpose: Paper sheet (#curtain, #F8F8F8, 24px top corners) that covers the page between navigations (transitions.ts). No sheet for back and forward, or under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-window
motion.value: clip-path inset, scrubbed, linear to scroll, from clamp(top 90%) to top 35%
motion.purpose: Signature 1: the hero sheet opens like a window as it scrolls into view.

motion.name: lamp
motion.value: radial-gradient 60vmax at --lamp-x / --lamp-y (fallback 50% 40%): rgb(253 190 100 / 0.11) at the centre, rgb(253 94 9 / 0.07) at 30%, rgb(253 94 9 / 0.03) at 52%, transparent at 70%
motion.purpose: Signature 2: a warm glow on the #111 ground that follows the pointer (the scroll on touch). An amber core at about 10% alpha, falling off through orange, so the ground still reads #111.

motion.name: nav-hide
motion.value: yPercent -100 and opacity 0 over 0.25s, ease-soft
motion.purpose: Floating nav hides on scroll down past 80px and returns on scroll up. Off on pages with data-nav-static.

motion.name: title-3d
motion.value: translate3d(10px, 51px, -60px) rotateY(60deg) rotateX(-40deg) to rest, power2.inOut, stagger 0.02
motion.purpose: 3D word swing on the section titles (data-title).

motion.name: card-tilt
motion.value: rotate up to 2.5deg, scale 0.97, 0.3s, ease-soft
motion.purpose: Pointer tilt on service and Why cards (data-tilt). Tilt only, no highlight. Skipped on touch.

motion.name: letter-roll
motion.value: translate 0 to -105% on hover or focus, 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1)
motion.purpose: Letter roll on the nav Initiatives link and Contact pill, the language switcher and the footer email (data-roll).

motion.name: path-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 on each path.draw[pathLength] in an svg[data-draw], 1.2s expo.out, 0.12s stagger, once when the top reaches 80%
motion.purpose: The hospital's heartbeat (the path.draw of its svg[data-draw]) draws in once as the figure comes into view. Without motion it is simply drawn. The Why arrow keeps its own scrubbed draw (home.ts).

motion.name: illustration-reveal
motion.value: svg[data-illo] top at 85% of the viewport (at load on the first screen): .frame paths draw in document order, stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0, 1.1s expo.out, 0.04s apart; then .light and .late fade in, 0.6s power3.out from 70% of the draw; Solidarity's windows then switch on bottom to top, 1.2s each, 3s in all
motion.purpose: A drawing of the Windows at night series draws itself in once as it comes into view: the window first, then the light. Hidden states are CSS gated on html.motion (illustration.css), so with motion off the drawing is whole.

motion.name: illustration-idle
motion.value: one gsap.ticker callback per drawing on screen, quantized gsap.quickSetter writes: spill opacity .9 to 1 and a 2.5% swell (4-6s); pages y -2 to -6 and 2deg (5s); moon x 2 (20s); leaf 2deg (4s); steam y -2 and opacity .6 to 1 (3s, two curls out of phase); a window blinks 0.8s every 25-40s; a bold segment crosses the heartbeat every 2.4s; a window flickers every 20s. Pointed at or focused tile: the light holds at 1, the swell and the moving parts double.
motion.purpose: Life at rest for the drawings: calm, small, no visible jump, eased in over 2s, paused off screen and in a hidden tab, absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: street-life
motion.value: one gsap.ticker callback while the footer band is on screen: flicker of ±0.15 opacity, capped at 0.8 inside a 70% group that the footer holds at 75% (the brightest window reads 42%); the lamp warms windows within 12% of the viewport width at most over 0.6s (scroll-driven on touch); one window lights or goes out every 20 to 40s; writes only on 0.05 steps
motion.purpose: Life at rest for the night street behind the footer logo: a skyline drawn once per page from its path (11 to 16 buildings, 3 to 9 floors, at most 208 elements), static under reduced motion and without JS.

motion.name: footer-logo
motion.value: svg[data-stagger] on the inline one-line logotype (goodeworkers-line.svg) in the footer band: each of its five paths rises 32 units (more than the lockup is tall, so the svg's own edge masks it), scales up from .96 and fades in, 1s expo.out, 0.06s apart in file order (orange e, Workers, lavender k, Good, star burst last), once the logo's top reaches 80% of the viewport; data-logo on its wrapper turns the star burst 360deg in 6s, linear and repeating, on hover only (none on touch)
motion.purpose: The footer closes with the logotype itself, on one line, staggered in, the star spinning on hover: a decorative, aria-hidden finale at min(100%, 72rem), about 9:1, over the night street. Whole without JS and under reduced motion.

motion.name: mark-pop
motion.value: scale 0.6 to 1, 0.8s expo.out, 0.2s delay, 0.06s stagger, starts with the nearest reveal or stagger
motion.purpose: In use by icon-pop: the hero and Why card icons. The engine reads it for any mark inside a reveal or stagger, so a mark grows in with the item it belongs to.

motion.name: icon-pop
motion.value: data-pop on the hero and Why card icons: scale 0.6 to 1, 0.8s expo.out, 0.2s delay, 0.06s stagger, starting with the card stagger
motion.purpose: The card icons are filled shapes, so each grows in as its card rises. The only markup that sets data-pop.

motion.name: tile-tilt
motion.value: data-tilt on the charter tiles and door cards: rotate up to 2.5deg, scale 0.97, 0.3s, ease-soft; no CSS hover scale on the element
motion.purpose: Value tiles and Initiatives door cards tilt toward the pointer. Tilt only, no highlight on hover or focus. Skipped on touch.

motion.name: value-underline
motion.value: background-size 0% → 100% (2px line at the bottom), 0.5s ease-out, on hover or focus
motion.purpose: Homepage value names: the underline draws in as the name is pointed at or focused.

motion.name: value-band
motion.value: 3px underline in the value's ink (skip-ink none); a band of that ink rises 0% → 100% over 0.5s ease-out on hover or focus, and the text goes #111 on the band
motion.purpose: The Initiatives values statement: each phrase links to its value's row on the values page.

motion.name: hash-glide
motion.value: same-page #hash link: Astro keeps the history entry, scroll restored, then a Lenis glide to the target (scroll-margin honoured); :target tint #1D1D1D on the row, fading in over 0.7s
motion.purpose: A charter tile glides to its value row on the same page, which then shows its tint. Back restores the place without a glide. Skip links stay native. From another page the row fades in place instead of rising.

narrative.overview:
The site is a near-black room with one bright, warm sheet laid on it. The dark ground (#111) carries the big statements, and the off-white sheet (#F8F8F8), rounded and pulled out to the column edges, carries the working material: the hero's service grid, the job-board table, the contact form. Colour is warm and used sparingly: orange for the one thing to do, yellow and lavender for the other paths, and a single hand-circled word in orange that marks what the heading is about.

It feels made by people, not by a template. Photos overlap at offset angles, the card grid is irregular, and the CTAs are fat pills with a heavy geometric label that grow slightly when hovered. Density depends on the ground: statements on the dark ground are centred and roomy, while working content on the light sheet can be dense, down to one line per row, because that is where the visitor gets things done.

Four colours also stand for the four values (Openness, Autonomy, Care, Solidarity) and keep that meaning wherever a value appears: the tile fill, the value's name on the dark ground, and the underline under its phrase in the Initiatives statement. The illustrations are drawn for the site: one small window at night per value, in pen line with one light colour, so the "made by people" feeling carries into the pictures.

The system is flat. It builds depth from the contrast between the two grounds, from panels overlapping, and from scale on hover. Shadows are not part of it.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds: #111 near-black and the #F8F8F8 rounded sheet, alternating down the page.
One orange ring around one word per heading.
Accents work as fills (pills, cards, value tiles, door cards), as dots and lines, or as a state (hover, current page). They never set reading text.
Four value colours with fixed roles: Openness yellow, Autonomy lavender, Care orange, Solidarity pantone.
A series of windows at night (one drawing per value, plus the hospital): pen line and one light, inline SVG that draws itself in and breathes at rest.
Fat rounded pill CTAs with a ClashDisplay bold label; `hover` scales them to 105%.
Inter for reading and UI; ClashDisplay for the brand name, names you click, value names, the 404 numeral and heading, and CTA labels.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either the #111 ground or the #F8F8F8 sheet, with #1D1D1D cards on dark and #ECECEC cards on light. Don't use a mid-value ground.

rules.name: The Orange Label Rule
rules.body: A label on an orange fill is pure white only at large bold sizes (the 30–40px ClashDisplay CTA). Smaller text on orange is black.

rules.name: The Dot Never Speaks Alone Rule
rules.body: A kind dot (10px circle) always sits beside its text label. The yellow dot on paper is well under 3:1, so the dot is only a wayfinding echo and can't be the only signal. Kind colours: remote-only yellow, vetted orange, startups and niches purple, freelance black, search engines pantone. On a pressed black pill, the dot gets a 1px grey ring so the black dot stays visible.

rules.name: The Value Colour Rule
rules.body: Each value owns one colour, everywhere it appears: Openness yellow, Autonomy lavender, Care orange, Solidarity pantone. The colour fills its tile, sets its name on the dark ground (Solidarity uses its lighter ink), and underlines its phrase in the Initiatives statement. A tile's drawing keeps a black pen and a paper light; on the night ground the value's colour is the light that spills. Never swap or reuse a value colour for a different value. Care's orange tile is a value field, not an action: on a page with the Care tile, the orange pill is still the only orange action.

rules.name: The Brand Voice Rule
rules.body: ClashDisplay appears only for the brand name, CTA pill labels, the footer contact heading, the 404 numeral and heading, value names (on tiles, in the homepage list and as value-row headings), and names or actions a visitor clicks (board and tool names, door-card actions). Other headings, taglines, prose and UI are set in Inter.

rules.name: The One-Weight Inter Rule
rules.body: Inter ships as one static Regular face, Inter-Regular.woff2, declared over weights 400–700 in `src/styles/global.css` on purpose. So every Inter `font-medium` and `font-bold` renders as Regular, with no synthetic bold, as the site was approved. The 500 and 700 weights in this file are the intended tokens, not what renders. Don't retune sizes or colours to make up for the weight.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: Every surface spans the column width, and its content aligns to the logotype. `.sheet` is the recipe: break out with `-mx-4 md:-mx-8`, re-pad with `px-4 md:px-8`. Nothing is inset, and nothing pads twice.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. A shadow may appear only to show a live state, as the stuck toolbar and the floating nav do. Hover is shown with scale (CTAs), colour fill, the pointer tilt on cards, or a small nudge of an arrow or a drawing's light.

dos: Do alternate the #111 ground and the #F8F8F8 sheet, and put every surface, paper or dark, on `.sheet` so that it spans the column width with its content on the logotype's line.
Do give each view one orange action, and use a pure-white label only on the large CTA pill.
Do encircle at most one word per heading, and pick it in the copy.
Do put a text label next to every kind dot.
Do use a 2px orange outline (or ring) with a 2px offset on every focusable element, except the pills on the dark thanks and 404 cards, which take a white outline.
Do keep ClashDisplay for the brand name, CTA labels, the footer contact heading, and names a visitor clicks.
Do show hover with scale (CTAs), fill (#ECECEC on the sheet, orange on the nav pill) or the pointer tilt (cards), and keep CSS transitions to 150–200ms.
Do keep `prefers-reduced-motion` switching off smooth scroll and transitions, and keep drawn lines fully drawn and static under it.
Do give each value its own colour everywhere it appears, and keep the four roles fixed.
Do set labels on a pantone fill in pure white, and on every other value fill in #111.
Do reveal a drawn line with `path.draw[pathLength]` inside an `svg[data-draw]`, and a whole drawing with `svg[data-illo]`.
Do draw a new illustration in the Windows at night series: the shared window, the 4-unit pen, the layer classes and the three grounds, inline in a component that says it was drawn for GoodEWorkers.
donts: Don't add resting shadows. The only shadows in the system are the state hairlines on a stuck toolbar and the floating nav.
Don't place the logo, or any surface, on a mid-value ground (`BRAND.md`).
Don't set small text in white on orange. Below large-bold size, labels on orange are black.
Don't use Tailwind's stock palette (gray-500/600/900, indigo-600) or stock UI recipes. Use the brand tokens and black alpha steps.
Don't add a second horizontal padding layer inside the shared column, and don't inset a card (`px-6`, `mx-4`, a narrower box). A surface is a `.sheet`.
Don't use glyph or emoji icons. Icons are inline SVG from `src/assets/icons/`, drawn in `currentColor`: line arrows, and filled shapes on the feature cards.
Don't add small uppercase labels above headings. The system has no eyebrow or kicker device.
Don't hotlink or rasterise illustrations, add a gradient, filter or shadow to one, or mix in drawings from another illustration style.
Don't colour prose or taglines with a value colour. Values show their colour as fills, as the ink of their names, and as underlines.
